Messages.Author: Jon
Messages.Body:
Just a quick question:

Methuselah A controls Millicent Smith.

Methuselah B blocks a mandatory hunt action of Methuselah A's minion
and wants to play Obedience to remain untapped.

I am pretty confident that the Millicent effect occurs and there is no
'about to enter combat,' so Obedience cannot be played, but I ask for
an official ruling just to be sure.

Thanks,

Jon

Millicent Smith:
During your discard phase, your predator takes control of Millicent.
If the Methuselah controlling Millicent has any of his or her
actioning vampires blocked, then Millicent and the acting vampire are
burned without combat.

Obedience:
Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with
an acting younger vampire.
Untap the acting vampire, do not tap this reacting vampire, and end
the current action (and combat). The acting vampire cannot attempt the
same action this turn.
As above, but do not untap the acting vampire.

not sure why you need an official answer. the cards' text answers it
right there. Millicent burns you without combat. Obediance is only
usable when about to enter combat. You are never about to enter
combat, so you can't play Obediance. Trust in thy self!
